required_safeguards: Static preflight passes before browser dependency installation or browser launch.
The pull-request base equals the authorized merged main commit.
The checkout equals the pull-request head.
The final pre-observation head is an exact one-file seal commit.
The seal binds the runner, workflow, verifier, authorization, directive, placeholder result, deterministic helper, and readiness evidence.
The workflow has no workflow_dispatch or reopened execution path.
Only pull_request.opened may enter the live observation job.
The runner performs one browser launch and one top-level page.goto.
The merged DOM click helper activates the installed Route Guardian handler.
PASS or FAIL_PRESERVED is committed before the workflow reports its truthful outcome.
Any later synchronize event validates evidence only and cannot observe again.
